crossRefs.note: “ ‘ “Moreover, when you divide by lot the land for inheritance, you shall offer an offering to Yahweh, a holy portion…
“It shall be eighteen thousand reeds around: and the name of the city from that day shall be, ‘Yahweh is there.’
Cry aloud and shout, you inhabitant of Zion; for the Holy One of Israel is great among you!”
Look at Zion, the city of our appointed festivals. Your eyes will see Jerusalem, a quiet habitation, a tent that won’t…
Many nations shall join themselves to Yahweh in that day, and shall be my people; and I will dwell among you, and you…
Yahweh will inherit Judah as his portion in the holy land, and will again choose Jerusalem.
What agreement does a temple of God have with idols? For you are a temple of the living God. Even as God said, “I will…
being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone;
For in him all the fullness of the Deity dwells bodily,
I heard a loud voice out of heaven saying, “Behold, God’s dwelling is with people, and he will dwell with them, and…
I saw no temple in it, for the Lord God, the Almighty, and the Lamb, are its temple.
There will be no curse any more. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants will serve him.

translations.web: “By the border of Judah, from the east side to the west side, shall be the offering which you shall offer, twenty-five thousand reeds in width, and in length as one of the portions, from the east side to the west side: and the sanctuary shall be in the middle of it.
translations.bsb: Bordering the territory of Judah, from east to west, will be the portion you are to set apart. It will be 25,000 cubits wide, and the length of a tribal portion from east to west. In the center will be the sanctuary.
translations.kjv: And by the border of Judah, from the east side unto the west side, shall be the offering which ye shall offer of five and twenty thousand reeds in breadth, and in length as one of the other parts, from the east side unto the west side: and the sanctuary shall be in the midst
translations.asv: And by the border of Judah, from the east side unto the west side, shall be the oblation which ye shall offer, five and twenty thousand reeds in breadth, and in length as one of the portions, from the east side unto the west side: and the sanctuary shall be in the midst of it.
